svg.title: 4K Omarchy desktop rendered on NVIDIA; wallpaper, bar and application verified; QMP input response demonstrated; backend 4 of 8 stages; product 0 of 4 gates
svg.desc: The first correctly rendered Hyprland frame is demonstrated at 3840 by 2160 with the shipped wallpaper, Omarchy bar and readable GPU application. One complete QMP keyboard, pointer and rendered-response run passes; its fresh repeat fails the unchanged GPU usage guard. Four backend stages are demonstrated and stages five and six remain in progress. No desktop product gate is complete. Physical Windows-window input, normal launcher integration, continuous multi-window display, reliability and matched-native performance remain open. Checklist counts do not measure engineering effort. Updated October 20, 2026.

g.text: First Hyprland frame achieved · Actual GPU backbuffer: 3840×2160
QMP keys + cursor + rendered response: one complete run passes
Fresh repeat fails the GPU-usage guard; physical Windows input remains unverified.
Next: physical Windows input, normal launcher and sustained multi-window display
Green: demonstrated · Amber: in progress · Gray: pending · Updated 2026-10-20
Diagnostic client: 1280×720 · Checklist counts do not measure effort or product readiness.
